rationale: SGA-to-SGA depot switch, most commonly driven by metabolic concerns (weight gain, glycaemic deterioration) or hyperprolactinaemia (sexual dysfunction, galactorrhoea, amenorrhoea, bone density concern). Aripiprazole LAI (Abilify Maintena) requires a mandatory 14-day oral aripiprazole overlap after the first injection. Paliperidone palmitate's long half-life (~25-49 days) provides seamless D2 cover during the oral overlap period and beyond — no coverage gap. Akathisia risk: as aripiprazole's D2 partial agonism replaces paliperidone's full antagonism, akathisia is the main switch concern. Counsel the patient early. Prolactin will drop substantially — patients with hyperprolactinaemia-related symptoms should notice improvement within weeks. Metabolic parameters (weight, glucose, lipids) should improve progressively as aripiprazole's metabolically neutral profile takes over. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Administer Abilify Maintena 400 mg IM (gluteal or deltoid) in place of next scheduled Sustenna. Do NOT give Sustenna today. Start oral aripiprazole 10 mg daily — 14-day oral overlap MANDATORY. PP-LAI tail continues releasing. Counsel patient about akathisia risk.
STOP oral aripiprazole today (14-day overlap complete). Abilify Maintena now therapeutic. PP-LAI clearing. Prolactin should already be falling. Monitor for akathisia.
Second Maintena 400 mg injection. PP-LAI substantially cleared. Review prolactin, metabolic parameters, akathisia. Monthly Maintena thereafter.
